facts.business: Maruti Global Industries Limited (formerly Maruti Securities Limited) is an infrastructure sector company that has recommenced business operations under new promoters.

auditor.name: Not specified in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Accumulated losses of ₹2,592.78 lakhs resulting in complete erosion of net worth; going concern assumption based on change in management, new promoters with infrastructure expertise, and recommencement of operations. Net profit of ₹72.37 lakhs reported for year ended 31 March 2026.

key_risks: Complete erosion of net worth due to accumulated losses of ₹2,592.78 lakhs
Going concern uncertainty despite management assessment
